name: PMO Enterprise Risk Register
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Risk:Link/PMO Enterprise Risk:220",
    risk_title AS "Risk Title:Data:220",
    entity AS "Entity:Link/PMO Entity:180",
    category AS "Category:Link/PMO Risk Category:180",
    probability AS "Probability:Data:110",
    impact AS "Impact:Data:110",
    score AS "Score:Float:100",
    owner AS "Owner:Link/User:180",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Enterprise Risk`
ORDER BY score DESC, risk_title
